content: निःसह {%a.%} .²1 Unable to bear, resist or suffer, impatient. .²2 Powerless, unnerved, spiritless, languid, fatigued; अयि विरम निःसहासि जाता <ls>Māl. 3</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">2</ls>, <ls n="Māl.">7</ls>; <ls>U. 3</ls>. .²3 Intolerable, unbearable, irresistible (in a passive sense).
.{@-सह@} ({@निःसह@}) {%a.%} .²1 Exhausted, powerless; कुसुमावचयपरिश्रमनिःसहं मे शरीरम् <ls>Nāg. 2</ls>. .²2 intolerable, irresistible.
